caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical tin container with a slightly domed, fitted lid featuring a small handle on top. The tin is primarily black in color and is adorned with a decorative floral motif on its side, which consists of a large, peach-colored rose with green leaves and a smaller, orange flower. A gold wavy line wraps around the upper part of the tin just below the lid edge. The container has a metal clasp or latch situated on the front to secure the lid, and the floral decoration runs horizontally across the midsection. The background is plain, light beige, and the tin is centrally placed on the paper with no other objects present. The drawing is rendered with attention to detail, accurately depicting the sheen and reflections on the metal surface.
title: Toleware Tea Cannister
